Its complete yod head recedes at the lower left, then expands into a distinct low-left body alongside the narrow right tail; an internal white window corroborates the separation. The same-page paired15 pointed yod has the same added low-left branch, whereas the paired plain yod and all three plain yods in this unit narrow into a right tail. Detached yod36 independently locates the interior point. The point is certified from the complete contour and literal controls, not from the white window alone. Append U+05BC after the existing yod tsere without reordering that vowel.

inspections.finding: The first physical Daniel is the right-hand word before על אשר. Its complete yod head recedes at the lower left, then expands into a distinct low-left body alongside the narrow right tail; an internal white window corroborates the separation. The same-page paired15 pointed yod has the same added low-left branch, whereas the paired plain yod and all three plain yods in this unit narrow into a right tail. Detached yod36 independently locates the interior point. The point is certified from the complete contour and literal controls, not from the white window alone. Append U+05BC after the existing yod tsere without reordering that vowel.

The second physical Daniel follows ויאמר. Its lower-left ink mass is broader than the plain controls, but the solid outline never exposes a characteristic low-left branch after a clear recession. The same-unit plain yods demonstrate that heavy heads and shafts can hook left; width alone does not uniquely distinguish a fully merged dagesh from a heavy ordinary impression. No equally opaque independently legible positive defeats that competitor. Retain the dagesh note. After the first Daniel gains the point, this unchanged later token is the sole remaining exact old anchor, so refresh its occurrence from 2 to 1.

The initial vav continues into a broad shallow foot or platform. Literal vav sheva preserves a two-level lower addition, ordinary shuruq vav shows the plain shaft foot, and detached patah, tsere and qamats preserve differing shallow-bar, transverse-pair and shoulder/stem classes. The target saturated footer does not distinguish a compressed vowel from ordinary thickening or uniquely select a vowel class. Retain the vowel note, refreshing only its anchor after the separately accepted yod dagesh.

Below the complete yod head there is a left-side recession followed by a distinct rounded low-left branch alongside the continuing right tail. Same-page paired15 pointed yod repeats this added branch; its plain counterpart and the three plain yods in this source unit narrow into the ordinary tail without the additional branch. Detached yod36 locates the interior dot independently. Certify U+05BC after the existing yod holam, preserving holam and all other scalars. The initial-vav vowel remains unresolved.
